authorization.owner: Authenticated owner control may explicitly administer registered Ghost mailboxes and notifications; original envelope actor remains owner in durable command provenance
authorization.ghost: Other authenticated principals may send only as themselves and read/ack only their own recipient inbox
authorization.transport: Principal is supplied by trusted transport, never derived from body sender_id, recipient_id or actor_ref; scoped mobile gateway does not expose collaboration administration

registry.ensure.authority: authenticated owner; Host verifies existing profile before ledger call

mailbox.send.same_key_different_payload: conflict with no partial recipient writes
mailbox.send.wake: none; durable mailbox is not model context

notification.inspect.content: opaque id, object identity, state; no artifact contents or personal transcript
